plan.title: BLOCKER: approved planning publication hits coverage and active-story membership gates

narratives.Description: BLOCKER: approved planning publication hits coverage and active-story membership gates
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

Approved planning-only Phase A refinement in FreshService AI cannot publish under Directive 0.125.0. Coverage applicability refuses `.deft/plan-sequence.json`; root plan/specification JSON separately classify as coverable live settings. Scope provenance binds the whole planning package to active A1 although A1 only updates five lifecycle lineage references.

## Reproduction

Consumer HEAD `d76ea56e17d7a3c559a8c5931eb75d7e68eadd92`, base `da867b00bd7a22ce6b9394bba8b3d2020697b4d3`, clean and unpushed. Local evidence: `.deft-scratch/phase-a-publication-blockers.md` and `.deft-scratch/phase-a-pre-pr-binding.json`.

- `deft coverage:hotspots --base-ref origin/master --json`: exit 2, unknown path classification `.deft/plan-sequence.json`.
- Committed `task repo:rehearse` under Node 24.20.0 passes 13 repository-transition tests, then `deft check` fails `verify:scope-provenance`: `change-set-outside-approved-scope`, 21 paths outside A1's merge-base membership. Application tests are not reached.
- Both failing checks independently reproduce against the exact base. Current Directive `origin/master` at `c01fe37c3` retains both mechanisms. Related: #5421, #5479, #5192. #5541 covers a distinct Bun-artifact case.

## Bounded planning shape

- A1 remains active/running with unchanged scope, acceptance, status, and implementation contract. Only five `parent_lineage.coverage_map.*.provenance.target_path` values change proposed to pending.
- Other nine Phase A stories remain pending, estimates unset. No implementation or execution proof.
- Root plan changes only timestamp and interviewContinuation targetDeliverable, reopenableDecisionSet, confirmations. Specification changes only timestamp and requirements/design narratives. PROJECT-DEFINITION changes only timestamp and generated registry items.
- Sequence retains 46 prior entries unchanged as parked history; current index 46 selects one `pr:phase-a-refinement` publication, continuation disabled.
- Other changes are documentation, decision, pending/proposed planning briefs, CHANGELOG/ROADMAP.

Earlier direct writes were denied under A1's implementation fence. Requirements posture admits docs/specs/proposed briefs but not pending briefs or root plan. David already applied reviewed content repairs manually; do not require repetition.

## Requested remedy

Diagnose whether this is false-positive implementation-gate application, a missing supported planning-publication workflow, or a legitimate scope prerequisite. Implement and document the narrow supported remedy, with content/type proof and bound Git evidence. Do not weaken a gate solely to pass this consumer diff.

Preserve enforcement for product changes, executable config, active scope/acceptance widening, forged authority, malformed or unknown artifacts, dirty/unbound diffs, and unauthorized lifecycle changes. No blanket exemption for `.deft/**`, xBRIEF JSON, docs JSON, or documentation diffs; no self-attested N/A.

Regressions must exercise the shared coverage classifier/pre-PR controller and scope-provenance entry point, including negative mixed-code/config/scope-expansion cases. Document the earlier write-time limitation without gratuitously broadening it.

No changes to installed/deposited consumer code, gates/policy, A1 scope, parked commit, or story statuses. Consumer upgrade/push/merge requires a separate handoff after review.

## Acceptance

- Tested supported publication path for this planning shape; precise explanation of any legitimate prerequisite.
- Meaningful negative enforcement regressions.
- Normal Directive quality gate, committed local CI rehearsal, pre-PR, Greptile 5/5, all review conversations resolved before mergeability.
- Exact recovery steps without reapplying content repairs or falsely completing controller `ppr_4f4f742a82a52988`.
